signature.name: National Theatre of Nigeria
signature.detail: A striking modernist landmark and the city's most famous sight, worth seeing for its bold architecture and cultural role. Go in the morning on a weekday to avoid crowds, and check ahead for any scheduled performances or events.

signature.name: Lekki Conservation Centre
signature.detail: A peaceful nature reserve with a famous canopy walkway, offering a break from the city's bustle. Visit early in the day for cooler weather and better wildlife spotting; wear comfortable shoes.

signature.name: Freedom Park Lagos
signature.detail: A former colonial prison turned memorial and arts venue, rich in history and local culture. It's best visited in the late afternoon when events often take place; entry is usually free or low-cost.

signature.name: Nigerian National Museum
signature.detail: Home to important archaeological and ethnographic collections, including the famous Nok terracotta pieces. Go on a weekday morning for a quieter experience; photography may require permission.

signature.name: Third Mainland Bridge
signature.detail: One of Africa's longest bridges, offering sweeping views of the lagoon and city skyline. Cross it during off-peak hours to avoid traffic; it's best experienced as part of a drive towards the island.

signature.name: Lagos Island waterfront
signature.detail: The historic heart of Lagos with colonial-era buildings and lively markets nearby. Visit in the morning to see the port in action, and be mindful of your belongings in crowded areas.

signature.name: Tafawa Balewa Square
signature.detail: A vast historical square where Nigeria's independence was celebrated, surrounded by iconic monuments. It's an easy stop while exploring the island; go early to avoid the heat.

signature.name: Nike Art Gallery
signature.detail: A vibrant gallery showcasing a huge collection of Nigerian art and textiles. It's free to enter and a great place to buy authentic souvenirs; open daily, but check hours before you go.

transport: Taxis and ride-hailing $5-15 for most trips; buses very cheap
